text: FIX an attachment id that contains `||` or starts with `|` could overwrite or delete the attachment data of another document, because the storages build the attachment key as `documentId + '||' + attachmentId`. BREAKING: `putAttachment()`, `putAttachments()`, `putAttachmentBase64()` and inline attachments now throw the error `AT5` when the attachment id contains `||` or starts with `|`
